name: metorial-outpost
description: Skills for building, configuring, and deploying a Metorial Outpost, the self-hosted MCP proxy that forwards signed, authenticated traffic to Metorial from your own network.

interface.shortDescription: Skills for building, configuring, and deploying a Metorial Outpost, the self-hosted MCP proxy that forwards signed, authenticated traffic to Metorial from your own network.
interface.longDescription: Metorial Outpost lets MCP clients and agents connect to a proxy inside your own network, which forwards their traffic to Metorial over a signed, authenticated channel. These skills cover the full path: registering an Outpost in the Metorial dashboard, writing the proxy with @metorial/mcp-proxy, configuring structured logging, and deploying it with Docker, Kubernetes, or another container platform.
